_**Agent (composer-2.5)**_

Here’s what changed:

### Fullscreen node inspection
In the expanded forest view, you can **click any node** on any tree. A detail bar appears above the grid showing:
- **Split nodes:** the full rule, e.g. `Leaf width ≤ 0.423 → left · Leaf width > 0.423 → right`
- **Leaf nodes:** the prediction and vote breakdown from training

Compact tree labels stay short (`f0`, etc.); the detail bar is where you see the full formula.

### Removed tree-card click-to-focus
Clicking a whole tree card no longer “focuses” it. Cards are plain containers now — only individual nodes are interactive.

During “Walk through trees” / “Merge votes”, the **currently animating** tree still gets a subtle highlight so you can follow the animation.

---

### About “focus tree” — you’re mostly right

Clicking a tree in fullscreen didn’t do much beyond an orange border. The **Focus tree** toolbar buttons (1, 2, 3…) are still there and still matter outside fullscreen:

| Where it matters | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Main tree panel** | Shows one tree at a time in the normal (non-expanded) layout |
| **Bootstrap stage** | Highlights that tree’s bootstrap bag on the scatter plot |
| **Walk / merge animations** | Cycles which tree is animating step-by-step |
| **Sidebar notes** | References “Tree N” in the live explanation text |

So focus isn’t useless overall — it’s just redundant when clicking tree cards in fullscreen, which is why that behavior is gone. If you want the toolbar focus buttons removed too, say the word.
